home.heroTitle: Helping you design, build, and scale mobile products.
paragraphs: Technical leader and full‑stack mobile developer with 18+ years in the software industry, partnering with founders and teams to ship production‑ready Android and iOS apps.
The focus is on clean architecture, maintainable code, and reliable releases—whether building from scratch or improving an existing codebase.
Consulting and training services help teams improve code quality, modernize their stack, and adopt better delivery practices through workshops and 1:1 mentoring.

contact.intro: For consulting, training, or new app development, the best way to start is with a brief message describing your product, current stack, and what you need help with.
